title.zh: 失效模式：介质、界面和连接各有指纹
title.en: Failure modes: dielectric, interface and connections have distinct signatures

subtitle.zh: 相同的电容偏差，可能来自完全不同的物理位置
subtitle.en: The same capacitance deviation can originate at very different physical locations

body.zh: 先看电气签名，再结合结构与制程历史定位；单一量测通常不能唯一锁定根因
body.en: Start with electrical signatures, then use structure and process history; a single measurement rarely identifies a unique root cause

body.zh: Via 开路、极板桥连、体接触不足、介质针孔
body.en: Open vias, plate bridging, insufficient body contact, dielectric pinholes

body.zh: 有效面积变化、残留/桥连、边缘场集中、介电常数变化
body.en: Effective-area change, residue/bridging, edge-field crowding, dielectric-constant change

body.zh: 固定电荷、界面陷阱、介质损伤、体接触不足
body.en: Fixed charge, interface traps, dielectric damage, insufficient body contact

body.zh: 界面陷阱、介质极化、残留/污染、粗糙界面
body.en: Interface traps, dielectric polarization, residue/contamination, rough interfaces

body.zh: 介质损伤/针孔、缺陷热点、边缘场集中
body.en: Dielectric damage/pinholes, defect hot spots, edge-field crowding

body.zh: 直流电阻/连通性、I-V全扫、结构截面
body.en: DC resistance/connectivity, full I–V sweep, cross-section

body.zh: 面积/周长缩放、截面/AFM、去残留工艺记录
body.en: Area/perimeter scaling, cross-section/AFM, residue-removal process records

body.zh: 正反扫对比、多频C-V、I-V相关性
body.en: Forward/reverse sweeps, multifrequency C–V, I–V correlation

body.zh: C-f/虚部损耗、温度依赖、表面与清洁历史
body.en: C–f/imaginary loss, temperature dependence, surface and cleaning history

body.zh: I-V与击穿分布、面积缩放、TDDB与PBD
body.en: I–V and breakdown distributions, area scaling, TDDB and PBD

body.zh: 量测反馈：I-V/ C-V/ C-f / TDDB / 缺陷图 /结构截面
body.en: Measurement feedback: I–V / C–V / C–f / TDDB / defect map / cross-section
Feed results back and iterate validation

body.zh: 边界：异常签名是排查线索，不是单项量测即可证明的唯一根因。
body.en: Scope: abnormal signatures are diagnostic clues, not unique root causes proven by a single measurement.
